notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Set Your Course For Alderaan (posted 'SYC/Ooooo Fireworks'), Death Star, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (posted 'DS DB'), Prepared Defenses, A Million Voices Crying Out, Something Special Planned For Them (posted 'SSPFT'), Mobilization Points; these count toward the 60.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 9 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set card named.
Posted 'DS DB' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327, the site the objective deploys; Alderaan, Sullust and Endor dested the Dark printings.
Posted 'Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); the card titled Maul is a later Virtual card. 'Piett' dested Admiral Piett and 'Officer M'Kae' Warrant Officer M'Kae.
Posted 'Grabber' is printed as written: There'll Be Hell To Pay and Allegations Of Corruption both fit.
The list totals 60 as posted. The strategy's closing 'Changes' (drop the grabber, swap a Lord Vader for Lateral Damage, start Imperial Arrest Order) are not applied.
